svg.aria-label: Oil Bleaching Unit piping and instrumentation diagram
svg.text: 1. All oil lines insulated and heat traced to maintain 180 degF minimum
2. Slurry lines sloped 1:100 to the pump suction with no pockets
3. Spent earth discharge valve is opened only for filter discharge
4. Assumed: Bleaching earth dosing and the vacuum system are on adjacent drawings
5. Assumed: Day tank design pressure taken as 15 psig for a nitrogen-blanketed atmospheric tank
